business_type_note: Operating real estate developer with recurring income streams (Real Estate development ~80% of FY2025 revenue, Leasing/Retail ~16%, Hospitality ~5%); primary methods per Business-Type Method Map are FCFF DCF, reverse-DCF, EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT, P/E, with NAV + SOTP as real-estate cross-checks. NOT a holding company. See 00_valuation-data-triage.md, 'Business type track' rows.

scenarios.drivers: Dubai property cycle holds; masked Emaar Malls annuity re-rates; DCF grid high / SOTP bull
